name: Внешний ЦАП iFi audio ZEN One Studio
descriptionHtml:
Внешний ЦАП iFi audio ZEN One Studio — The ZEN One Studio is a D/A converter with USB, S/PDIF and Bluetooth inputs.

  • Digital inputs: USB 3.0 Type B (USB 2.0 compatible), S/PDIF via 3.5mm
  • Supported formats: PCM up to 32-bit/384kHz, DSD256/11.3MHz, MQA decodi
  • Frequency response: 5Hz–80kHz ±3dB
  • Signal-to-noise ratio: -105dB(A) at 0dBFS (balanced/unbalanced)
  • THD+N: <0.002% at 0dBFS (balanced/unbalanced)

Характеристики

Digital inputs: USB 3.0 Type B (USB 2.0 compatible), S/PDIF via 3.5mm coaxial, Bluetooth 5.1 · Supported formats: PCM up to 32-bit/384kHz, DSD256/11.3MHz, MQA decoding, Bluetooth up to 96kHz · Frequency response: 5Hz–80kHz ±3dB · Signal-to-noise ratio: -105dB(A) at 0dBFS (balanced/unbalanced) · THD+N: <0.002% at 0dBFS (balanced/unbalanced) · Dimensions: 158 × 100 × 35mm · Analogue outputs: Balanced XLR L/R and 4.4 mm balanced line output.

It has balanced XLR and 4.4mm stereo outputs and no headphone amplifier or volume control.
shortHtml: ZEN One Studio – это передовой цифро-аналоговый преобразователь, обеспечивающий непревзойденный уровень производительности в своем классе, поддерживает форматы: DSD256, PCM384, MQA384kHz, Bluetooth 96KHz.
